description: This file defines the implementation class 'pucch_allocator_impl' for the PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) allocator interface within a 5G NR scheduler. It includes class methods for resource allocation, multiplexing, and management of PUCCH grants, as well as internal data structures for tracking grants and resources.

classes.name: pucch_allocator_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the PUCCH allocator interface, managing resource allocation, multiplexing, and grant tracking for Uplink Control Channel in 5G NR.

classes.name: pucch_grant
classes.description: Represents a PUCCH grant allocated to a UE, including type, format, associated UCI bits, and resource configuration.

classes.name: pucch_grant_list
classes.description: Maintains a list of possible PUCCH grants (HARQ, SR, CSI) for a UE in a given slot.

classes.name: ue_grants
classes.description: Tracks PUCCH grants (common and dedicated) assigned to a specific UE identified by RNTI.

classes.name: slot_context
classes.description: Tracks PUCCH allocations within a specific slot, including methods to find and clear grants.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates internal slot tracking and resets PUCCH resource grid based on slot indication.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Handles deactivation of the cell, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: alloc_common_harq_ack
methods.description: Allocates common HARQ-ACK PUCCH resources for a given RNTI and DCI info.

methods.name: alloc_common_and_ded_harq_ack
methods.description: Allocates both common and dedicated HARQ-ACK resources.

methods.name: alloc_sr_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates SR (Scheduling Request) opportunity for a UE.

methods.name: remove_ue_uci_from_pucch
methods.description: Removes UCI bits for a UE from PUCCH.

methods.name: has_common_pucch_grant
methods.description: Checks if a UE has a common PUCCH grant in a specific slot.
